summary: Fix watch --record recording the wrong raw scene on a parse-index mismatch.
reason: parseFeatures drops features that fail to unmarshal, so the parsed slice can be shorter than rawFeatures. The loop recorded rawFeatures[i] using the parsed-slice index i, which misaligns after any skipped entry and upserts the wrong scene under --record. Now iterates rawFeatures directly and unmarshals inline so raw and parsed always correspond.
